data.narrative:
Armadin is a Defense & Security sector company founded by Kevin Mandia, Travis Lanham, David Slater, and Evan Pena. The target's current stage and valuation remain undisclosed, as does total capital raised to date. The relevant comp universe spans 10 private firms and 2 public entities (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS), drawn from a broader Defense & Security peer set of 26 companies. Top private comparables include Anduril Industries, Helsing, Castelion, Shield AI, and Saronic.

The peer-median method proved inapplicable due to insufficient narrow-stage and tier-matched datapoints. Within the Defense & Security sector's 26 identified peers, no same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar-valuation-tier clusters met the minimum three-company threshold required for reliable median triangulation. An all-sector fallback median would introduce unacceptable distortion given the heterogeneity of business models, maturity, and revenue profiles across Defense & Security subsectors.

This analysis cannot produce a supported valuation range without either: (i) disclosure of Armadin's revenue, growth rate, or capital raised; (ii) comparable transaction or funding round data from the identified peer set; or (iii) sufficient stage-aligned peers meeting statistical minimums. Material uncertainty around stage, prior funding, and operating metrics precludes quantitative synthesis at this time.
